# 00000007395

**English.** Definition: Odd reflections with the odd permutations of root systems. Conjecture: The group generated by odd reflections is the automorphism of the root system, and the quotient is the extension of the Weyl group. (Weyl-extending odd-reflection group)

**中文。** 定义：奇反射：根系的奇置换。猜想：反射的群：奇反射生成的群为根系的自同构且构的商为 Weyl 群的扩张。（奇反射 Weyl 扩张根系自同构商生成群）
